question.text: The workbook recommends evaluating FIRR/IRR alongside multiples such as TVPI because IRR on its own:

answer.text: Already captures fees, taxes, and absolute value created
May not provide the exact picture when investment options are compared only on FIRR, so investors need multiples for a more realistic view
Is the only metric SEBI permits to be disclosed
Cannot be calculated for AIF fund lifecycles

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states FIRR/IRR considers time value and uneven cash flows but may not provide the exact picture when investment options are compared only on FIRR. Investors are advised to look at FIRR together with multiples such as TVPI for a more realistic view. The Trap: Option B mirrors the source's caution. The other options misstate IRR's coverage, its regulatory status, or its applicability to AIFs. Note: Earlier wording used specific early-distribution and small-fund-size examples and 50% IRR/1.3x TVPI vs 20% IRR/3.0x TVPI contrasts. Those numeric mechanics are not directly supported by the checked workbook and have been removed; only the IRR-plus-multiple evaluation idea is retained.
